utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Sam, before I share anything widely, can you confirm what your tool crew can actually cover—small appliances, basic bike tune-ups, or just tool support?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can confirm we’ve got tool support covered, and I’m comfortable saying basic bike tune-ups too; I’m still checking before we promise small appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Sam — I’ll mark your crew as confirmed for tools and basic bike tune-ups, and leave small appliances as pending until you check back.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Bo, Noah’s the one coordinating volunteers, so I’d check in with him. I’m bringing drills, clamps, a spare workbench, and hand tools, but I bet they could still use help with setup and sorting.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Gus—that helps. I’ll check with Noah and see if he needs me for setup or sorting.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Bo—thanks for jumping in. If Noah says they need any extra gear, send him my way and I’ll see what I can dig up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Faye, do you have the latest repair list or sign-up sheet, and can you tell me which repair types still don’t have volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, Mina—I’m still waiting on Mara to confirm the date, repair list, and which slots or repair types are uncovered, so I don’t want to send around guesses.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Then hold off on sending anything; I’ll press Mara for the confirmed list and gaps, and once she has it you can help get the word out.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Noah—what I know is mostly second-hand, but Quinn seems to be keeping people looped in. I’m just floating near the small lamp and chair repairs with basic tools nearby.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli—that helps; I’ll point folks with lamp or chair fixes your way, but I’ll still check with Quinn or Leo before I repeat anything too official.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. Keeping it unofficial until Quinn or Leo confirms sounds best—I’ll just quietly help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oren, I’ve got your spare screwdrivers and socket set noted as coming this afternoon, but I won’t mark tools covered until I hear what else is pledged.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That’s wise, Cleo—please keep mine as pledged but not covered yet, since I’m bringing them this afternoon and don’t know what else has been promised.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Got it, Oren—I’ll keep your screwdrivers and socket set marked as pledged for this afternoon, not covered, until the rest of the tool promises come in.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Jules, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive so nobody misses it—want the details, or know anyone with tools or something that needs fixing?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, please share the details you’re using—I’m lining up small appliances, torn clothing, and basic bike tune-ups, with drop-off by Friday evening and no bulky items yet.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Jules—I’ll share that: small appliances, torn clothing, and basic bike tune-ups, drop-off by Friday evening, and no bulky items yet.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Dane, I’m still checking the repair drive details before I spread the word—have you heard anything confirmed from Cleo about the time, drop-off spot, or what tools they need?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Tess, I’m still catching up too, and I haven’t heard anything confirmed from Cleo yet. What I’ve got is tentative: small appliances, loose bike brakes, torn clothing, and screen door patches, but I’d hold off sharing time or drop-off details until Cleo confirms.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Dane—I’ll keep those repair items as tentative and won’t pass along the time or drop-off until Cleo confirms. If you hear from her first, will you nudge me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hi Leo—before we announce anything wider, can you confirm whether the community room side door is okay as the drop-off spot for the small appliances and bikes by Friday evening?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, use the community room side door for small appliances and bikes by Friday evening. I’ll tell Opal to mark it and Cleo to add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect, thanks—please make sure they say small appliances and bikes only, and Friday evening is the cutoff so we have time to sort.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Rey—I’m updating the repair drive map now, so tell me which block you’re covering and any tools or supplies your station needs nearby.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Opal—I don’t want to overstate it, but I’m not covering a block yet; I’m still waiting on the meeting time and can help with parts sorting or coffee once it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rey—I’ll mark you as flexible for parts sorting or coffee, pending the meeting time, and leave your block unassigned for now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Vik, I’m still working off second-hand updates on the repair drive—so far I’ve heard tools, spare parts, and handy volunteers are useful, but do you know who’s coordinating the latest list?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yep—Cleo’s keeping the latest list, so I’d check with her for anything exact. What I’ve been passing around is that it’s today and folks should bring tools, tape, spare parts, snacks, and handy help if they can.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That helps a lot, thanks—I’ll point folks to Cleo for the exact list and only pass along those basics as second-hand for now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli, I’m glad we could connect about the repair drive—since it’s now Sunday at the community center, I’m gathering everyone’s input on what repairs feel most urgent.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rosa—before we rank urgency, I’d like to see Mina’s sign-up sheet sorted by repair type. Once we know what’s actually listed and who’s helping, we can set Sunday’s priorities clearly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes perfect sense, Eli—I’ll check in with Mina about sorting the sign-up sheet by repair type, then we can use that to set Sunday’s priorities together.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Kira, I’m still verifying the repair drive details while I’m out—Quinn’s on outreach and Cleo’s tracking supplies, but I’m trying to confirm who has the actual repair signup list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Ira—please confirm who actually has the signup list and the final date before I tell anyone. Once Cleo verifies the needed supplies too, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely—I’ll hold off on sharing anything firm until I confirm the signup list holder, the final date, and Cleo’s supply needs.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Mara—please get Quinn and Opal to send me the repair list, sign-up sheet, and uncovered stations today so I can stop guessing and start assigning people.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Mina—I’ll ask Quinn and Opal today to send you the repair list, sign-up sheet, and uncovered stations so you can start assigning people.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—please copy me on the message, and if they don’t answer by this afternoon, tell me so I can chase it directly.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Jules, I’m still waiting for Mara to confirm the exact date and busiest slots, since I’m trying to work around school pickup and drop-off. I’ll pass along the repair list and supply needs as soon as the organizers verify them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that helps a lot. I’ll hold off on firm scheduling until Mara confirms, and I’ll keep the current list to small appliances, torn clothing, and basic bike tune-ups for now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Jules — that’s exactly where I am too. I’ll nudge Mara again and let you know as soon as we have the date, busiest slots, and any confirmed supply needs.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Pia, I’m still verifying before I tell Eli anything firm—do you have the current repair signup list, or know if Leo has it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I don’t have a confirmed signup list yet, Ira, and I wouldn’t send Eli anything firm until we know whether Leo has the latest version and the organizers confirm the drop-off spot.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Pia—thanks. I’ll check with Leo next and hold off on giving Eli anything firm until the list and drop-off spot are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Plan is still Saturday morning collection, with the parts list by noon. I’m waiting on Pia to confirm exactly which repairs we’re accepting, then I’ll point you to a clear task.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Leo—that helps. I’ll hold off on telling folks specifics until Pia confirms, and I can help with setup or bring some small tools Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good plan—bring the small tools Saturday, and I’ll text you the confirmed repair list and setup task once Pia replies.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Vik, I’m just catching up, but it sounds like the repair drive is covering small appliances, torn clothing, bike tune-ups, and screen door patches—are you already signed up for one of those?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m not signed up for a specific repair station yet—I’m mostly spreading the word this afternoon and pointing folks to Cleo’s list for the official slots.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it, thanks—I'll check Cleo’s list before I claim anything, and if there’s still a gap I can help steer late volunteers toward the bike tune-ups or screen door patches.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Rey, I’m keeping the supply list cautious for now—tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks are noted, but I’m still checking what’s actually pledged. Have you heard any confirmed needs for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Only what Oren told me so far: small-appliance and bicycle fixers, plus people to sort parts and make coffee. Eli also mentioned getting the sign-up sheet open so we can mark who’s covering what.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — I’ll mark those as needs, not pledges yet: appliance and bike fixers, parts sorters, coffee help, and a sign-up sheet to track coverage.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Sam, I’m spreading the word about the repair drive—Opal’s still mapping stations, so if you’ve got tools or something to fix, can you note your block and what you’d bring?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Quinn—I’m on Maple block, and I can bring a folding table, extension cords, and a basic toolkit for setup and small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Sam—I’ll pass along Maple block with the folding table, extension cords, and basic toolkit to Opal so she can place you where it helps most.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Eli—I’m updating the repair drive map now, so tell me where you’ll be stationed and what tools or supplies you’ll need nearby.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Put me near the small-appliance and household fixes table, Opal. I’m bringing screwdrivers, pliers, a wrench set, and an extension cord, but I want to confirm Mina’s sorted sign-up list before we lock the map.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it, Eli—I’ll pencil you in by small appliances with those tools and hold the placement as tentative until Mina confirms the sign-up list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I’m still confirming the repair drive date before I pass it around, but can you tell me what you’ve heard from the organizers so I’m not spreading guesses?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’d keep it quiet until Quinn confirms the date; all I’ve heard is that Sam may know more about the tool setup, and Cleo’s still checking the supply list.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, that helps—I’ll hold off sharing until Quinn confirms the date. Can you point me to Sam for the tool setup and let me know when Cleo has the supply list verified?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Rosa, I’m a bit slammed and only catching pieces—do you know the confirmed repair drive date or who’s coordinating volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes—it's been moved to Sunday at the community center, and I’m coordinating volunteers while I gather everyone’s input. If you’re slammed, just tell me what kind of help you can offer and I’ll plug you in gently.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Rosa—Sunday at the community center, got it. I can do a short setup shift or help sort tools and parts, just don’t put me on anything that needs a lot of back-and-forth.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Tess, I’m bringing drills, clamps, the spare workbench, and plenty of hand tools for the repair drive—anything else you think we’ll be short on?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Gus, that sounds like a strong start—before I send folks your way, I’m still checking with Cleo on the confirmed supply gaps, but spare parts and a couple handy volunteers may be the next thing we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Tess—send folks my way once Cleo confirms, and I’ll dig through my bins for spare screws, hinges, brackets, and any useful bits too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Nell, I’m checking details before we spread anything—do you have the confirmed time and place, plus who’s covering appliance and bike repairs?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I don’t have the confirmed time or place yet, Hana, so I wouldn’t spread that part. I’ve only heard second-hand that folks may need help with small appliances and bike brakes, but I’m still trying to confirm who’s covering what.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Nell — I won’t share time or place yet, and I’ll mark appliances and bike brakes as unconfirmed until we know who’s actually covering them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mina, I checked with Eli and he says you may have the current sign-up sheet, so I’m checking with you first like promised. Do you have the list, or should I track down Cleo next?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don’t have the current sheet yet, Ira—please track down Cleo and ask for both the repair list and who’s already signed up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Got it, Mina—I’ll go find Cleo now and ask for the repair order plus the sign-up names, then I’ll report back to you this evening.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rey, the repair drive is today; Cleo has the list, so bring any tools, tape, spare parts, or snacks you can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Leo. I’ll bring some tape and spare parts, and I can help sort once Cleo has the list set.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect—check in with Cleo when you arrive, then help sort the first urgent repairs.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Hana—I’m laying out the repair drive map now, so tell me where you’ll be stationed and any supplies or neighbors I should place nearby.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Opal—I don’t want to place myself until I know the confirmed repair lanes and coverage. Can you share which categories are locked in and who’s covering appliances and bikes?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: So far I’ve got appliances and bikes marked as active lanes, but I don’t have confirmed leads written down yet—once Sam, Mara, or Quinn gives me names, I’ll pin coverage and send you the exact spots.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Pia, I’m helping coordinate Saturday morning’s repair drive and I’m already counted in—do you need me on setup, tools, or one of the repair lanes?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Sam — before I place you, can you confirm with the organizers where drop-off and setup are happening? Once that’s nailed down, I’d rather put you where the biggest gap is instead of guessing.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, I’ll check in with Opal and Jules now to pin down the drop-off and setup spots, then I’ll report back so you can place me where I’m needed most.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Uli, my next step is to check Mina’s sign-up sheet and sort it by repair type; after that I’ll know what’s still missing, and I’m already set to help Saturday with my tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Eli—that sounds useful. If Mina’s sheet shows any quiet gaps, maybe let Quinn or Sam know before it gets passed around.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That’s a good plan, Uli; once I’ve checked Mina’s sheet, I’ll flag any gaps to Sam and Quinn before we circulate it further.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Faye, I’m still holding off on spreading the word—have the organizers confirmed the date and the actual repair or supply needs yet?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Not yet, Kira—I’m still waiting on Mara to hear back from the organizers, and I don’t want you sharing anything unconfirmed. I’ll send you the date and the real needs list as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Faye—please send me Mara’s confirmed details when they come through, and I won’t pass anything along until then.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Jules, I’m mostly caught up, I think—the repair drive is Saturday morning, and Gus is bringing drills, clamps, and a workbench. I’m still double-checking the current repair list before I tell anyone the wrong thing.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s right, Noah—tell folks we’re keeping the list to small appliances, torn clothing, and basic bike tune-ups for now, with drop-off by Friday evening and no bulky items yet.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Got it, thanks Jules—I’ll share small appliances, torn clothing, and basic bike tune-ups only, with Friday evening drop-off and no bulky items. I’m writing that down before it slips sideways on me.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Cleo, I’m pretty slammed but trying to help with the repair drive—do you know what still needs covering or who I should check in with?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Bo — I’m still confirming before I mark anything covered, but the likely supply list is tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks for appliance, bike, clothing, and screen repairs. If you’re short on time, could you check with Dane on the repair categories or ask Rosa what outreach/volunteer gaps are still open?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll do a quick check with Dane on the repair categories and, if I can squeeze it in, ask Rosa about outreach gaps before I tell anyone it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Mara, I’m glad we could connect about the repair drive—it’s now Sunday at the community center, and I’d love to hear what repairs you think we should prioritize.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa—since it’s Sunday at the community center, I’d prioritize small appliance fixes, clothing mending, and basic furniture tightening, especially if Gus’s tools are coming through. I can also check back with Opal and Quinn so our stations match the volunteers and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds like a strong, practical set of stations, Mara—thank you. If you can check with Opal and Quinn, I’ll start penciling in small appliances, mending, and furniture tightening for Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Quinn, Ira says you’re handling outreach and Cleo has the supply list—should I tell folks to bring tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks for this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, please tell them that, Tess—and add that if anyone’s unsure, they can still come by and we’ll match supplies to repairs when they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks Quinn—I’ll tell folks to bring tools, tape, spare parts, and snacks this afternoon, and that anyone unsure can still come by to be matched with repairs.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Oren, I’m still working off second-hand updates, but I’ve heard tools, spare parts, and handy volunteers are still needed—do you know who’s coordinating the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m a bit fuzzy on the whole thing, Nell, but Vik’s been spreading the word and seems to know the latest; Ira may have the firm details too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Oren—that helps. I’ll check with Vik or Ira before I pass anything along as definite.
